title: UK album release: Live In Japan by George Harrison | 1992
content:
Live In Japan, George Harrison’s 12th solo album, was released in the United Kingdom on 13 July 1992.

Credited to George Harrison with Eric Clapton and Band, it was the last album to be released in Harrison’s lifetime, and the follow-up to the hugely successful Cloud Nine.

Live In Japan was released the following day in North America.

The album did not chart in the UK, and peaked at number 126 on the Billboard 200. In Japan it reached number 15 on the Oricon chart.
